events.title: The Updated Demo for 《Frontier Tale》 Arrives October 20 for Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hello again, pioneers!We’re bringing an updated demo of 《Frontier Tale》 to Steam Next Fest, available to play from October 20!After our last demo, you shared plenty of suggestions and feedback. Since then, we’ve been discussing your comments and making changes. Thank you to everyone who took the time to share their experience and help us improve the game.Important Note Before PlayingPlease start a new save after this update. events.title: Frontier Tale Demo Test Has Ended | See You at Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Since the launch of the Frontier Tale Demo, we've received so much feedback, so many suggestions, and plenty of encouragement from players.This was the very first time Frontier Tale was officially shown to everyone, so we'd be lying if we said we weren't nervous! events.title: Frontier Tale Demo Version 1.0.5 Update Announcement
events.summary: Hello, dear Trailblazers!Thank you very much for taking the time to try out our game during the Demo playtest. We sincerely appreciate every valuable feedback, suggestion and bug‑report you have submitted. We have carefully reviewed all comments from players and completed a round of optimizations and fixes accordingly. This Demo update is now ready.
